programmes.d: In search of the Doctor, an antimatter creature attacks UNIT and the Doctor is forced to send an SOS.
Following the advice of the First Doctor, the Third Doctor and Jo have crossed through the black hole.
The Doctors are trapped in the universe of antimatter.
Omega intends to escape his antimatter world and needs the Doctors to take his place.
The TARDIS lands on a 1926 ship.
The Doctor faces Drashigs.
The Doctor escapes a trap.
The Doctor races to save Jo.
The Doctor and Jo land on a spaceship in the far future.
Neither the humans nor the Draconians are willing to believe the Doctor.
Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help.
Accused of being spies, the Doctor is sentenced to imprisonment.
The Doctor and Jo are the Master's prisoners.
On Draconia, the Doctor reveals the Master's plan to provoke war.
Injured by an Ogron gun, the Doctor asks the Time Lords to send the TARDIS.
The Doctor recovers from his coma and befriends a Thal expedition.
The Doctor breaks out of his prison cell and joins forces with the Thals.
The Doctor and the Thals escape from the Dalek city.
The Daleks plan to release a plague.
A force of ten thousand Daleks is coming to life.
In Wales, a dead miner is found glowing green.
Investigating the old mine workings, Jo and miner, Bert, become trapped.
The Doctor and Jo discover the mine's terrible secret.
The Brigadier attempts to seal the giant maggots in the mine with explosives.
Captain Mike Yates is taken over by the super computer.
Cliff is dying, and maggots are on the verge of transforming into giant flying insects.
An alien crashes in medieval England.
Sarah stows away aboard the TARDIS.
Irongron attacks Sir Edward's castle.
Linx prepares to take off.
The Doctor arrives in London to discover the city is completely deserted.
The Doctor captures a dinosaur to solve the mystery of the invasion.
The Doctor is placed in danger by enemy sabotage; Sarah is kidnapped.

While Sarah is held prisoner, the Doctor comes closer to solving the mystery.
The Doctor becomes a fugitive and is hunted across London.
The Doctor, Sarah and the Brigadier try to stop time from being thrown into reverse.
The TARDIS lands on an alien planet.
The Doctor must ally with Daleks.
The Daleks hunt the Doctor.
Sarah tries to trick the Daleks.
The Doctor visits the planet Peladon for the first time in fifty years.
Chancellor Ortron sentences the Doctor and Sarah to be punished by Aggedor.
The Doctor attempts to expose the fraud of Aggedor's ghost.
The Ice Warriors take control of Peladon and the Doctor must find a way to stop them.
Commander Azaxyr and his Ice Warriors are revealed as traitors, in league with Galaxy 5.
The Doctor and the miners fight to reclaim Peladon from the Ice Warriors.
The Doctor receives a mysterious package from his old companion, Jo Grant.
Lupton, now under the control of a giant spider, steals the blue Metebelis crystal.
Following Lupton, Sarah is accidentally transported to Metebelis 3 where she is captured.
